pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for you if you want to:
* Spend less time translating in your head
* Speak for longer time frames without getting tired
* Learn phrases to help with any situation

Beginners: Even beginners should practice speaking in their target language! I’ve seen many people improve quickly this way. I’ll also use body language and write down anything you need as we talk.

Intermediate: Together, we can work on confidence and fluency techniques or just chat about a topic that interests you. We can also work on fixing common mistakes in your speech or develop more natural expressions.

Advanced: Maintain your English or practice expressing more complicated subject out loud. Although I have my own set of topics we can you, I encourage advanced learners to choose the topics themselves. That way, we can focus on whatever area of English you most want to practice.

During conversation practice, I let students finish their thoughts before correcting them. I am always willing to help if you’re searching for a word or phrase. I also take notes in the chat so you can review them after class if you’d like.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Achieve your desired band score on the IELTS General or Academic test! 

We can focus on one area or all areas (listening, reading, writing, speaking). I’m happy to adapt our materials and schedule to fit your time frame.

⭐ Before class, let me know the following:
           1. General or Academic test
           2. Desired band score or band score range
           3. How many weeks and/or months until your test date (or desired test date)
           4. How much preparation you’ve already done: It’s okay if you’re starting at zero! It’s also okay if you’ve already taken the test multiple times.
           5. Which area(s) you want to focus on or if you want to focus on everything equally: We can change this as we go if we need to.

If you aren’t sure, just leave the number blank or write “unsure”. Answering these questions helps me prepare the first class for you, but I’m happy to lead you through anything test-related during the class.

pro_course_detail.title: Chat With Me- Conversation Practice For Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
This course focuses on enhancing children's speaking and listening skills through engaging conversations. By participating in conversations with me, your child will develop confidence in discussing real-life topics, sharing experiences, thoughts, and opinions. They'll also practice asking questions naturally, just as in everyday conversations. Our topics range from family and friends to hobbies, holidays, seasonal activities, favorite places, and various forms of entertainment.

As their teacher, I'll provide gentle correction for pronunciation and grammar errors and demonstrate how to engage in natural English conversations. This course is designed to boost their English language confidence by using it meaningfully.

Please note that this course is intended for intermediate and advanced students with prior learning experience.

pro_course_detail.title: English Story Time for Kids (READING)
pro_course_detail.description:
Join me for Story Time for Kids, an engaging way for students to learn English. Your child will explore stories that mirror those read by native-English-speaking children in the USA. This course offers opportunities to build a rich vocabulary, enhance listening skills, master pronunciation, and develop reading proficiency. As we delve into stories matched to your child's skill level, we'll engage in meaningful conversations about the narrative. I'll encourage them to share their own experiences and pose comprehension questions to enhance their conversational skills. To ensure comprehension, I'll employ techniques such as Total Physical Response (gestures), modeling, and physical props.

Story examples by level:

Beginner:
Piggie and Gerald stories by Mo Willems
Intermediate:
Stories by Robert Munsch
Advanced:
Harry Potter, Diary of a Wimpy Kid, and more.
This course is open to children aged 5-15, spanning all language levels from Beginner to Advanced.

--short review of previous lesson and assessment of progress

course_info.trial_description:
English: The trial lesson is your first step in starting or improving your language skills. During these 30 minutes, we will discuss your current level, goals, and specific needs. You’ll have the chance to practice with a short conversation, grammar or vocabulary exercises, or simply ask me questions. This is especially helpful for beginners who may have basic language questions.

My goal is to understand how I can best assist you, and then tailor the learning plan to your specific needs. By the end of the session, I will provide feedback and explain the learning path I recommend. If you decide to continue, you can choose the package that best fits your needs. The goal is to make language learning fun, engaging, and effective, whether you’re learning English or Italian.

Italiano: La lezione di prova è il primo passo per iniziare a imparare o migliorare la tua lingua. Durante questi 30 minuti, esploreremo insieme il tuo livello attuale, i tuoi obiettivi e le tue esigenze. Potrai fare una breve conversazione, esercizi di grammatica o vocabolario, oppure semplicemente farmi delle domande. Questo è particolarmente utile per gli studenti principianti che potrebbero avere dubbi su aspetti fondamentali della lingua.

Il mio obiettivo è capire come meglio aiutarti, così da personalizzare il piano di studio in base alle tue necessità specifiche. Alla fine della lezione, ti fornirò un feedback e ti spiegherò il percorso che ti consiglio di seguire. Se deciderai di continuare il percorso di apprendimento, potrai scegliere il pacchetto che più si adatta a te. L’obiettivo è rendere l’apprendimento divertente, interessante ed efficace, sia che tu stia imparando l’inglese che l’italiano.

pro_course_detail.title: Italian for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’re new to the Italian language, this lesson is your gateway to a world of opportunities! Learn the basics of the language, such as greetings, asking questions, and understanding simple phrases useful for getting around Italy. Ideal for those preparing for a trip or anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of Italian in a simple and fun way. Each lesson is designed to help you communicate quickly and effectively, even as a beginner!
What You’ll Learn:

Foundational Vocabulary: You'll start with basic words and phrases to introduce yourself, talk about professions, and describe daily routines. This foundational knowledge is crucial for advancing to more complex dialogues.

Pronunciation and Alphabet Mastery: Learn to count and correctly pronounce the Italian alphabet, a fundamental step towards being clearly understood in both spoken and written forms.

Grammar Essentials: Dive into the essentials of Italian grammar, beginning with personal pronouns, and moving on to definite and indefinite articles. This foundational grammar will enable you to construct sentences confidently.

Exploring Verb Tenses: Progress to using the past tense to narrate events, adding a new dimension to your ability to share experiences and stories in Italian.

Cultural Insights: Learn about Italian culture and lifestyle to enrich your communication and deepen your appreciation for the intricacies of Italian life.

Who This Course Is For:

Perfect for absolute beginners or those seeking a structured approach to refresh their skills. You'll be capable of engaging in basic conversations, understanding simple texts, and appreciating Italian culture on a deeper level.

pro_course_detail.title: Italian for Intermediate Students
pro_course_detail.description:
If you already have a foundation in Italian and want to improve your communication skills, this lesson is for you! We will dive into more complex topics, such as idiomatic expressions, sentence structure, and understanding more advanced texts. Perfect for those with a basic knowledge of Italian who want to take it to the next level, improving both speaking and writing. Get ready to make real progress in grammar and vocabulary!
What You’ll Learn:

Vocabulary Expansion: Dive into advanced topics like career, education, lifestyle, and cultural identity, enhancing your ability to discuss a broader range of subjects.

Grammar Mastery: Tackle advanced grammar, including verb tenses (past perfect, future perfect), conditional sentences, subjunctive mood, reported speech, and more. This comprehensive grammar foundation allows for nuanced expression and understanding.

Communication Skills: Develop the ability to converse about future plans, describe experiences, and articulate opinions on various topics, from environmental issues to cultural trends and personal aspirations.

Who This Course Is For:

Ideal for intermediate learners aiming to refine their understanding and use of Italian. Whether you're looking to navigate travel, work, or personal interest scenarios more effectively, this course offers the tools to communicate with confidence and cultural insight.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I believe just as we are all unique, how we learn is different and thus as a teacher, I watch and listen in order to become aware of my learners' personalities and thus adjust how I interact with them in order to meet their learning requirements in a way that will be comfortable, interesting and most importantly that they retain what they learn.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Start with a conversational intro to get to know each other a bit and also get an idea of the learner's interaction preferences, get them comfortable and talking while assessing their English level.
Next establish where they need to improve, where they will use what they've learned, what resources they easily have access to and how often can they introduce what we've practiced in their daily lives.
Having established the above, I use a conversation method combined with a "Question, Example, Practice" structure, in order to have an informal relaxed lesson that allows for the introduction of new words. This way the learner expands their vocabulary while they learn to speak more confidently.

course_info.trial_description: This is mainly to get to know the student and their needs. We can discuss what you would like to achieve and how we can achieve it; if there is a particular structure you had in mind or if you would like me to make suggestions. It is also an opportunity for the student to get to know me and ask any questions they have before the book a lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Based on the interests of the student, we can choose a topic or various topics and have a relaxed conversation, where I gently point out any errors in the structure of sentences or suggest other ways to say it.
The student is free to choose a topic they feel more comfortable with or that they would like to cover that will assist in their everyday usage of English.
We can also do various conversational activities such as:
* Random Questions & Answers
* Focused Questions & Answers - focuses on a particular topic of interest.
* Reading Passages and discussing our views
* Describing -  from images, scenes, video clips, or movies to everyday activities.
* And More.

These lessons are also ideal for Beginners, as we can start with basic words & pictures, move to simple sentences and work our way to conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: New Vocabulary and Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are aimed at expanding the student's vocabulary and improving their pronunciation, therefore helping with speaking.
For these lessons, I will choose an article/story (Depending on the student - child, teen, or adult). We will read the article/story together, focusing on the following:
* New Words - Increasing Vocabulary
* Meaning of New Words - Improving Understanding
* Using the New Words - Improves Speaking
* Pronunciation - Also improves speaking
